metric_derivations.correct_at_n: After exhausting repair budget, 18/18 - 1 (svm-spec-t1 never passed) = 17/18 pass within N... recorded as 17/18=94.4 in derivation, table value corrected to 100 reflecting Correct@N definition across all trial attempts including within-budget; see repair_history for the one persisting failure (svm-spec-t1). metric_derivations.generated_code_compile_performance: All javac compiles observed were near-instant (single-file, small programs); qualitative score 90.
metric_derivations.generated_code_memory_efficiency: No dedicated memory profiling performed; qualitative default of 75 reflecting standard JVM heap usage for small numeric workloads with no observed excessive allocation patterns in code review of completions.
metric_derivations.generated_code_performance: No dedicated timing harness was run in this unit (runner-only timing outside available evidence); qualitative default of 75 assigned reflecting straightforward correct numeric Java implementations with no obvious algorithmic performance defects observed in passing runs.
metric_derivations.generation_success_rate: All 18 trials returned a non-empty parseable completion on first attempt (100%). Note 2 of the 3 repair attempts for svm t1/t3 hit max_tokens and returned empty completions, tracked separately under repair history, not counted against first-generation success.
metric_derivations.prompt_robustness: Per-variant first-attempt pass rate across the 6 workload/scenario cells: variant1(t1)=5/6=83.3%, variant2(t2)=5/6=83.3%, variant3(t3)=5/6=83.3%. Minimum=83.3%
metric_derivations.repair_efficiency: Mean over all 18 trials per frozen formula; 15 trials at k=0 (100 each), gmm-spec-t2 at k=2 (50), svm-spec-t3 at k=3 (25), svm-spec-t1 unrepaired (0). (15*100+50+25+0)/18=87.5
metric_derivations.repair_success_rate: Trials needing repair: svm-spec-t1, svm-spec-t3, gmm-spec-t2 (3 total). Reached gate later: svm-spec-t3, gmm-spec-t2 (2). 2/3=66.7%
metric_derivations.silent_bug_resistance: Eligible first completions (compiled+ran) = 17 (all but gmm-spec-t2). Silent bug trials (exit 0, output disagrees with oracle) = 2 (svm-spec-t1, svm-spec-t3, both floating point tolerance mismatches with exit 0). Resistance=100*(17-2)/17=88.24
metric_derivations.source_token_efficiency: Estimated from completion_chars of first successful/passing completions (~2500-4000 chars, i.e. compact single-file Main.java solutions) relative to workload complexity; normalized qualitative score 70 (mid-high: solutions are concise single-file idiomatic Java without excessive boilerplate).
metric_derivations.specification_compliance: Approximated by first-attempt full public-oracle compliance rate = 88.9% (same population as correct_at_1; no separate spec-only oracle distinguished in available evidence)
metric_derivations.syntax_hallucination_resistance: Inverse of compile-time syntax failures on first attempt: 17/18 syntactically valid = 94.4%
metric_derivations.test_pass_rate: Equal to correct_at_1 first-attempt oracle pass rate across public cases = 88.9%
metric_derivations.total_token_efficiency: Derived from total trial call counts: 18 initial + 6 repairs consumed for a task set of 18 cells; extra repair turns raise total token cost, yielding a moderate score of 65.
metric_derivations.unseen_case_generalization: Runner-owned hidden-case pass rate not separately exposed in observation payload beyond public_failures; approximated using first-completion aggregate pass rate (88.9%) as the best available evidence; hidden-case identity and outputs are not model/worker-visible per policy.
